title: Prescription Insurance on File — Handling-Class Share on Re-Billed Cash Fills
content:
**Prescription Insurance on File** lists drugs by handling class for re-billed cash fills: the class share is read from the handling class of the re-billed fill's own prescription, as held under Prescriptions.

| Handling class of the re-billed fill's prescription | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | 0.9 |
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | 0.95 |
| Any other class — Schedule V Controlled Prescription, Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription, Schedule II Controlled Prescription or Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | 1 |

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent is made once, at the end.

## Points of judgement

- The class read is that of the prescription the re-billed cash fill belongs to, not of the patient's other prescriptions.
- *Hypothetical:* a patient's most recent cash fill is for a Non-Controlled Acute Prescription, while the patient's other prescriptions are maintenance prescriptions: the charge is multiplied by 0.95.
